_note: SAMPLE DATA. Illustrative entries for the Relstate devnet demo, written by hand. The institutions and venues are real places and the coordinates are approximate, but the occasions and dates below are placeholders invented for the demo. Nothing here is a real schedule, and no organisation listed is a partner of Relstate or has endorsed it. Replace wholesale before this page is shown as anything other than a demo.

items.name: Autumn semester starts
items.blurb: The biggest single arrival week in the city. Thousands of students look for a room in the same fortnight, and most of them have no Polish rental history.

items.name: Erasmus+ arrival week
items.blurb: Exchange students arrive for one or two semesters, usually without a Polish bank account and almost always on a short lease.

items.name: Second-term intake
items.blurb: A smaller February intake, when the autumn rush has cleared and more flats are free.

items.name: Winter exam session
items.blurb: Short stays while exams run, close to the campus and the tram line into the centre.

items.name: Technology conference season
items.blurb: A conference week on the river bend opposite Wawel. Walking distance matters more than size for a four-night stay.

items.name: Summer festival weekend
items.blurb: An open-air weekend on the meadow west of the centre, with the park between it and Old Town.

items.name: City marathon
items.blurb: A one-night stay where being near the start line is the entire requirement.

items.name: Autumn semester starts
items.blurb: The main campus sits on Krakowskie Przedmieście, so anything within a tram stop of it goes quickly.

items.name: Freshers' week
items.blurb: First-year arrivals, most of them renting for the first time anywhere and with no record at all.

items.name: Graduate recruitment season
items.blurb: Final-year students moving for a first job, often into a flat they need before the first salary arrives.

items.name: Trade week at the stadium
items.blurb: Across the river from the centre, with the metro making the east bank the practical place to stay.

items.name: Park concert season
items.blurb: Sunday afternoons in the park through the summer, a reason to take a short lease on the south side.
